title: Night Rain under the Moon
music_prompt: Calm, soothing ambient music for deep sleep on a quiet rainy night: soft gentle rain falling steadily on leaves and grass, distant night birds and a few crickets in the wet meadow, a light breeze moving through tall grass. Over it, warm slow analog pads, sparse soft felt piano notes with long reverb like moonlight, a low gentle cello drone, and a very soft, breathy wordless female vocalise humming quietly far in the background. About 52 BPM, key of A minor turning warm, no drums, no percussion, no lyrics, no spoken words, no thunder, no sudden changes, no build-ups, no crescendo, no climax, no fade-in and no fade-out: it starts and ends at the same soft, quiet level, the volume stays low and perfectly even for the whole track so it loops seamlessly, peaceful and safe.
